name: Shenzhen SEG Co.,Ltd
summary: Shenzhen SEG Co.,Ltd, established in 1996 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, operates as a subsidiary of Shenzhen SEG Group Co., Ltd. The company primarily engages in China's electronics market, while also delivering a diverse array of services including urban and property management, specialized inspection, testing, and certification, and the development and ongoing operation of photovoltaic power generation facilities.
